evals.prompt: what should I work on today?
evals.expected_output: Prioritized action items based on board state, blocked issues, and PRs awaiting review
expectations: Queries the project board for active work items
Presents a prioritized list of action items with rationale
Includes a Suggested Skills section based on current context

evals.expected_output: Formatted table of all available harness skills with descriptions
expectations: Lists all skills from the Available Skills dynamic context
Presents them in a table format with name and description
Includes a tip about /pm suggest and /pm <skill-name>

evals.expected_output: Context-aware skill recommendations based on time of day, branch state, and PR status
expectations: Reads current context (branch, time, recent commits)
Suggestions are contextually relevant to the user's current state

evals.expected_output: Detailed information about the plan skill including description, arguments, modes, and usage examples
expectations: Identifies 'plan' as a skill name lookup
Reads the plan SKILL.md for full details
Presents description, arguments, modes, usage examples, and related skills

evals.prompt: are there any blockers on the board?
evals.expected_output: List of blocked work items with reasons
expectations: Queries the project board for blocked items
Presents each blocker with work item ID, summary, and blocking reason

evals.prompt: project status — focus on what's incomplete or blocked
evals.expected_output: Project summary that includes documentation gaps alongside blockers and WIP
expectations: Queries the project board for active work items
Identifies documentation debt as a priority item
Includes Documentation Gaps section showing work items with missing deliverables and their tier
